note: Family-owned since 2011 on Patterson Creek Village Pike, about 9 mi from Cumberland MD. Seasonal packages are sold alongside the nightly sites (weekends-only Thu-Sun $450/month, full-time resident $850/month, May 1-Oct 10 season, a whole row $1800), so expect a mixed transient/seasonal park; cabins and a pavilion are separate products. On-site Fireside Inn restaurant and lounge, camp store (ice, firewood, beer, propane), live music Fridays and karaoke Thursdays, playground and yard games, creek swimming and fishing, weekend community float trips. Late check-in by phone. RV Life counts 80 sites; the operator does not publish a site count or a max RV length. Note the operator's own warning that GPS mis-routes to the address - they direct drivers to Patterson Creek Village Pike off WV-28. --Claude
summary: Fees $50-54 confirmed (pre-tax, 2026 page); water/sewer and year-round confirmed manual; derived site count 80 cleared (RV Life only). Booking left as derived (pages give phone/form, no reservation statement). Note: dropped the rate, year-round, phone-booking and RV Life restatements.
flags: US$50 gate: base is exactly $50 before tax ($54 holiday weekends) - at the line, over it once tax is added. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Shenandoah NP 85 km) and the family has not stayed here (no trip references).

Long-stay test: the camping page sells 'Full Time Resident - $850' a month and a May 1 - Oct 10 weekends season alongside nightly sites, and invites inquiries on 'permanent waterfront lodging'. Nightly sites are clearly for sale, so it reads as mixed transient/seasonal rather than residential, but the full-time-resident product is worth AWH's eye under the five-test rule.

Waterfront re-audit lead: the camping page offers 'permanent waterfront lodging' and the home page says 'Family Campground Near Water' with 'Swimming and Fishing in Patterson Creek'; the entry is 'not waterfront'.

Phone 304-298-4380 confirmed on the operator's pages (office; fax 304-298-4383). A Google Maps lookup by name matched a different Eagle's Nest (Glen Jean, WV), so there is no Maps review count for this one.
